title: British Bass with Italian-Style Brine
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Italian-style bass dish with a flavorful brine marinade.
instructions: Rinse the bass fillets and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together the dry white wine, brine, and sea salt to create the marinade.
Place the bass fillets in a shallow dish and pour the marinade over them.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the bass from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bass and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil.
Bake the bass in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Serve the bass hot, garnished with additional fresh basil if desired.
